title: Compact smart telescope offers two views of the night sky
caption:
Forget hours of assembly. This compact smart telescope uses motorized tracking and dual lenses to help beginners capture galaxies and constellations with just a smartphone app.

Source: Newatlas - Compact smart telescope offers two views of the night sky
